text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove is hard on herself and others, but always looks out for those in need. She is the Empress that many Umamusume look up to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In pursuit of her dream to be the ideal for all Umamusume, she prepares to take on the Twinkle Series.
